summary: libetude-case's empty disk on NVMe and CD under the stand-in for QEMU, each fault in a private copy of posix/scenario.c found by the media row

argv: exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -O1 -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I tests/host -I tools/etude/include -I tools/etude -I tools/etude/posix -I tools/etude/guest -I utils tests/host/etude_scenario_hosttest.c ${SRC}/tools/etude/posix/scenario.c tools/etude/posix/case_main.c tools/etude/serial.c tools/etude/posix/qemu.c tools/etude/qemu_profile.c tools/etude/posix/exec.c tools/etude/posix/keeper.c tools/etude/processor.c tools/etude/posix/process.c tools/etude/posix/store.c tools/etude/capture.c tools/etude/history_json.c tools/etude/guest/guest.c tools/etude/guest/fixture.c tools/etude/guest/wire.c utils/sha256.c -o ${WORK}/etude_scenario_hosttest

faults.name: blank-again
faults.summary: the second boot makes the empty disk again, in place of the first boot's

faults.name: blank-size
faults.summary: the empty disk has half its declared size

faults.name: blank-kept
faults.summary: the empty disk is left in the scratch after a pass

faults.name: cd-copy
faults.summary: a CD's medium is a private copy, not the store's object

edits.find: m->disks[i].path = d.cdrom ? etude_artifact(c, name) : etude_private_copy(c, name);

faults.name: discard
faults.summary: a disk's discard is not given to the launcher

faults.name: serial
faults.summary: a disk's serial is not given to the launcher
